items.title: OpenAI Safety Employee Resigns, Citing 'Broken Culture'
items.summary: A safety employee at OpenAI has reportedly resigned, publicly stating that the company's culture is 'broken,' raising concerns about internal dynamics at the leading AI firm.

items.title: Survey of Post-Training and Alignment Techniques for Video Generation Models
items.summary: A new survey paper provides a comprehensive overview of post-training and alignment methods crucial for improving the performance and safety of video generation models.

items.title: InterEvolve: Test-Time Evolution of Reward Programs for Humanoid Loco-Manipulation
items.summary: Researchers introduce InterEvolve, a novel method enabling test-time evolution of reward programs to enhance humanoid robot loco-manipulation capabilities, improving adaptability in complex environments.

items.title: Google Summarizes September 2026 AI Innovations and Updates
items.summary: Google's AI blog provides a roundup of its key artificial intelligence announcements and advancements made throughout September 2026, highlighting ongoing progress in various AI domains.

items.title: X-Tree: Tokenizing Reusable Experience for Efficient Agent Generalization
items.summary: A new paper proposes X-Tree, a method for tokenizing reusable experience to significantly improve the efficiency and generalization capabilities of AI agents across diverse tasks.

items.title: All the AI Agents That Can Live in Your Text Messages
items.summary: TechCrunch explores the growing landscape of AI agents designed to integrate directly into text messaging platforms, offering users various automated services and interactions.

items.title: Decentralized Master-Mind: Joint Action Refinement in Multi-Agent Pathfinding
items.summary: This research introduces Decentralized Master-Mind, a system for joint action refinement through iterative intent denoising, optimizing multi-agent pathfinding in complex scenarios.

items.title: Persona Dosing: Calibrated Activation Steering for Graded Trait Control
items.summary: Researchers present Persona Dosing, a technique for calibrated activation steering that allows for fine-grained control over specific traits in AI models, enabling more nuanced persona generation.

items.title: Chatham Financial Scales Capital Markets Expertise with OpenAI
items.summary: Chatham Financial announces its collaboration with OpenAI to enhance its capital markets expertise, leveraging advanced AI to streamline operations and improve financial insights.

items.title: SILSA: Sliding-Window Slice Latents for Topology-Preserving High-Resolution 3D Generation
items.summary: SILSA is introduced as a new method utilizing sliding-window slice latents to achieve topology-preserving high-resolution 3D object generation, addressing challenges in 3D content creation.

items.title: Decoding Looped Transformers Better for (Almost) Free
items.summary: A new paper presents an efficient method to improve the decoding performance of looped transformers with minimal computational overhead, offering practical benefits for AI model deployment.

items.title: Ego2Act: Evaluating Goal-Directed Manipulation in Egocentric Video Generation
items.summary: Ego2Act proposes a new benchmark for evaluating the effectiveness of goal-directed manipulation in egocentric video generation, crucial for developing more capable embodied AI.

items.title: Omni-Embed-Mini: Binding Modalities Without Forgetting via Dense Distillation
items.summary: Omni-Embed-Mini introduces a dense distillation technique that enables models to bind multiple modalities without experiencing catastrophic forgetting, improving multimodal learning.

items.title: PhysVista: Benchmarking Physical Intelligence in VLMs via a Perception-Reasoning-Assessment Loop
items.summary: PhysVista offers a new benchmark to evaluate the physical intelligence of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) through a comprehensive perception-reasoning-assessment loop.

items.title: Smaller Models, Better Rejects: Preference Distillation Scaling
items.summary: This research explores how preference distillation can be scaled to create smaller models that are more effective at rejecting undesirable outputs, enhancing AI safety and control.
